description: This file defines a migration class for version 5.6.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It contains database schema modifications, language string translations, and configuration updates pertinent to the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for database schema and data updates during the system migration to version 5.6.0. Implements methods to modify tables, insert permissions, and update language strings.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration, including language string updates, schema modifications, creating new tables for OpenID providers, and related configurations.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '5.6.0' indicating the migration target version.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates language string version in the database to the specified version.

methods.name: modifyAuthProviderTables
methods.description: Alters the schema of the OpenID provider table, updating certain column properties.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of LangStringHelper used for language string operations.

methods.name: removeOpenIdProviders
methods.description: Deletes or updates OpenID provider entries based on their provider type.

methods.name: changeGoogleProviderURL
methods.description: Updates the URL of a Google provider in the database.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes language string translation entries associated with a specific unit ID and group ID.
